description: Health tracking and consultation application with AI assistance, virtual doctor appointments, fitness/nutrition tracking, and peer video conferencing.

designSystem.accentColor: #C62828 (Ox Red for dark mode notifications / custom highlights)

localStorageKeys.authToken: Authentication token for Authorization header Bearer token.
localStorageKeys.user_session: JSON object with { email, firstName, userId, loginTime } representing active user session.
localStorageKeys.profile_{email}: Cached user profile data with _cacheTime metadata to avoid redundant network calls.
localStorageKeys.cached_wallet_balance: Cached wallet balance in local currency/credits.
localStorageKeys.ai_data_sharing_consent_granted: Boolean ('true'/'false') indicating if the user consented to share health data with third-party AI service.
localStorageKeys.medical_disclaimer_accepted: Boolean ('true') indicating if the user accepted the startup medical disclaimer.
localStorageKeys.notifications_history: Backup list of notifications for offline reading or fallback retrieval.
localStorageKeys.blocked_users: List of user profiles/IDs blocked by the user to moderate objectionable content.
localStorageKeys.user_reports: User-generated reports flagging objectionable content for developer/admin review.
localStorageKeys.track_data_{dateStr}_{email}: Aggregated daily tracking status containing steps, meals status, BP logs, sugar logs, exercises, and sleep.
localStorageKeys.fitness_score_{dateStr}_{email}: Daily fitness score (up to 2.0 pts) calculated from goal achievements.
localStorageKeys.fitness_deck_swiped_{dateStr}_{email}: Array of swiped goal IDs for the current calendar day to prevent repeat point awards.
localStorageKeys.food_score_{dateStr}_{email}: Daily food score (up to 2.0 pts) calculated from meal selections.
localStorageKeys.food_deck_swiped_{dateStr}_{email}: Array of swiped meal IDs for the current calendar day to prevent repeat point awards.

actions.updateBalance: POST to `/post/balance.php` with { email, amount } (negative for deduction, positive for top-up).

coreScreens.name: MainScreen
coreScreens.behavior: Reads `user_session` local storage. If session exists, replaces route with Dashboard. Else, redirects to Login.

coreScreens.name: LoginScreen
interactions: Upon successful verification, stores auth token and user_session, then replaces route with Dashboard.

coreScreens.name: DashboardScreen
coreScreens.purpose: Main health panel presenting summary stats, daily recommendations, and fast navigation to modules.
uiComponents: Dynamic greetings ('Good Morning', 'Good Afternoon', 'Good Evening') based on local time.
Health score status dial displaying score (1.0 to 10.0) and label ('Excellent', 'Very Good', 'Normal', 'Needs Attention').
Summary metrics cards: steps, completed meals, sleep hours, water intake.
AI Health Tip component: displays contextual healthy tips. Reloads tip every 5 minutes.
Low balance notification banner linking to Paystack top-up modal if wallet balance < 5000.
Medical Disclaimer modal: must be accepted on first launch, stored as accepted in local storage.
AI Data Sharing Consent modal: prompts user to approve sharing data with OpenAI/OpenRouter proxy.

aiIntegration.description: Requests custom AI advice from /ai/global.php config, sending user context (vitals, goals, health score) to get actionable wellness tips.
aiIntegration.intervalChecks: Every 30 minutes, checks vitals and logged meals, generating notifications for health updates or missing meal logs (breakfast, lunch, dinner reminders).

coreScreens.name: AIDocScreen
coreScreens.purpose: Interactive health support chat with AI assistant 'Dr. Helen'.
uiComponents: Chat window with user and AI messages bubble differentiation.
Voice dictation microphone button (integrates Speech-to-Text).
Quick action chip navigation: Hospitals locator, MyFood logging, Doctors list, Vital signs tracker, Call a Doctor shortcut.
Language translation modal allowing translation of AI responses.
Paystack top-up button directly visible when balance is insufficient.

coreScreens.name: TrackScreen
coreScreens.purpose: Logging vital stats and computing unified health score.

trackedVitals.bloodPressure: Systolic, Diastolic, and Pulse rate values.

healthScoreCalculation.bpAnalysis: +1.0 bonus for normal BP (110-130 / 70-90), penalties up to -4.0 for critical high values.
healthScoreCalculation.sugarAnalysis: +0.5 bonus for normal sugar (70-140 mg/dL), penalties up to -2.5 for highly abnormal values.

coreScreens.sharing: Supports generating health reports and sharing them via WhatsApp URL or Email custom templates.

coreScreens.name: FoodScreen
coreScreens.purpose: Logging daily meals and analyzing calorie/nutritional components.
uiComponents: Nigerian Healthy Meal Suggestions Swipe Deck: Tinder-like card system (Jollof Rice, Moi Moi, Efo Riro, etc.). Swiping right logs the meal, plays a coin drop sound effect, and awards health points.
Manual Food Log dialog (input name, description, meal category).
Photo Uploader / Camera Capture linking to image picker. Uploaded images are passed to AI for nutritional analysis.
Daily calorie/macronutrient tracking summary (Calories, Protein, Carbs, Fats).

coreScreens.name: FitnessScreen
coreScreens.purpose: Activity logging, fitness tasks recommendation, and goal tracking.
uiComponents: AI Daily Fitness Tasks: JSON array list generated by AI representing suggested workouts.
AI Lifestyle Guide component displaying warm, holistic wellness recommendations.
Fitness Goals Suggestions Swipe Deck: Swipe right on targets (Lose Weight, Cut Sugar, 30m Cardio, Strength Training) to earn points and play sound effects.
Logs editor for active steps, exercise minutes, and water intake.

coreScreens.name: DoctorsScreen
interactions: Retrieves doctor profiles directory from app backend (https://app.presibo.com/doctors.json).
Booking Modal: input phone, consult reasons, schedule date/time.
Applies a booking charge (100 credits) deducted from wallet balance.
Sends booking confirmation emails to both patient and doctor.
Saves appointment notification log in system backend.

payload.name: Recipient Name
payload.subject: Appointment Confirmed/Scheduled Details
payload.body: Formatted HTML text email containing date, time, and participant profiles.

coreScreens.name: TrainersScreen
coreScreens.purpose: Browsing and booking personal fitness trainers.
coreScreens.behavior: Fetches trainers list from https://presibo-wl.vercel.app/trainers.json, filters items where specialization is 'Fitness Trainer', and logs appointments at `/appointments/new.php`.

coreScreens.name: MeetingsScreen
uiComponents: Displays list of upcoming and past virtual consultations.
Join Consultation button: initiates LiveKit/Jitsi room name.
On joining, stores appointment status as 'ongoing' and launches WebRTC video room.

coreScreens.name: VideoRoomScreen
coreScreens.webrtcEngine: Jitsi Meet embedded inside standard browser frames / WebViews.

meetingSession.behavior: Hooks unload / conferenced left events. On completion, calculates call duration in seconds and submits a POST request to update call status to 'ended'.

coreScreens.name: ProfileScreen
coreScreens.purpose: Comprehensive profile dashboard and financial wallet management.
features: Displays user demographics, health statistics, and upcoming consultation details.
Paystack Checkout implementation: allows topping up wallet balance.
Wallet action: can send payment invoice/reminders via email.
Self-Assessment module: user reports symptoms, triggers AI analysis, saves result, and shares via WhatsApp/Email.

items.name: Account Information
items.purpose: Form to edit firstname, lastname, tel, age, sex, blood_group, address.

items.name: Privacy & Security
items.purpose: Contains password resets, Privacy Policy access, AI Data Sharing toggle (and gpt/grok disclosures), and Account Deletion workflow (requires typing 'delete' and entering password).

coreScreens.name: NotificationsScreen
interactions: Mark as Read: PUT request to `/notifications/index.php?id={notificationId}` with { is_read: 1 }.
Clear all notifications: empties state and removes local history.
